claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.build_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is a single authored unit whose first rule is a permanent character-build choice among six ancestry boons. The current species-trait surface only admits passive or activation mechanics directly; it cannot encode a build-time choice over multiple branches honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following benefits-a supernatural boon from your ancestry

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.triggered_reaction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Two ancestry branches are reaction-shaped and consume the shared Giant Ancestry use pool. Species traits cannot currently author triggered reactions even though the shared non-spell surface already has that family for magic items.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant). When you take damage, you can take a Reaction...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.on_hit_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Three ancestry branches are hit riders that trigger when the bearer hits with an attack roll and deals damage. Species traits cannot currently author on-hit trigger mechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Fire's Burn (Fire Giant). When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.
